description: Activity rows for goal renames use the goal's current title as the subject and show only the old value. Dev renamed the goal to "Faster checkout" and Tomás to "Checkout p95 under 400 ms". Both rows first read "renamed goal Checkout p95 under 400 ms". After the conflict was resolved, both read "renamed goal Faster checkout", so Tomás is shown renaming the goal to Dev's wording. The value each person wrote is never shown.
expected: "Tomás Ferreira renamed goal Cut checkout latency → “Checkout p95 under 400 ms”" and "Dev Raman renamed … → “Faster checkout”", stable over time.
actual: Both rows: "renamed goal Faster checkout / Was “Cut checkout latency”".
suggested_fix: Render goal.update title events with the event's own new value (payload) as the detail "Now “…”", and the old title as the subject.

description: Title and description Keep buttons are named by author with the actor kind inside the possessive: "Keep Dev Raman · human's title". The value they keep is not in the button.
suggested_fix: Use the value (truncated) for short text fields; drop the actor kind from the button.

description: Resolving a description conflict logs "Kept the chosen version", which does not say whose version or what text. Title resolves say Kept “Faster checkout” and status resolves say Kept Dead end.
expected: "Kept Tomás Ferreira's description" with an excerpt.
suggested_fix: Include the author and a short excerpt in description resolve rows.
